title: Explore the north for the next two base sites: Aldebaran, Yildun, Hawthorne, Alchiba and every system within two jumps of them, read twice a turn
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-17 19:26 UTC for orders.log ENT-042 (block ORACLE, P4 b): about ten scouts explore the north (Aldebaran to Alchiba) and the south (Biham, Felis) first, for the next sites, and the report names the candidates 3 or 4 systems out with their fields, lanes and pirate record (rule F33). The list: every system within two lanes of Aldebaran, Yildun, Hawthorne and Alchiba (table lanes), taken from census-roads so that no system stands on two lists of ours; nearest to home first. They lie 5 to 13 systems beyond our border and 7 to 15 jumps from home; their reads were 4.8 to 7 hours old at the turn of 19:15 UTC (table places). The near tier of the north (Nightveil, GSC-0049, Denebola at 3 systems out, Acrab and Marfik at 4) stays on census-frontier and census-worked. No station with fuel and a market stands in the region (table stations: two ENDL outposts and a HEXC outpost), so a trip starts and ends at home; `chain` 3 within two lanes reads up to four systems a trip; tank 95 against about 40 jumps for the farthest trip. Every 180 minutes so that each system is read twice in a turn of four hours (the threshold is the floor of a gap). Five ships: four explorers and the scout with a survey scanner, which surveys each system it reads (census.py). An empty hold (rule F13); a pirate met is filed for Military (observe.py), the scout reads and leaves (rule F27).
